blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Coach LA Tenorio saw what he expected from TNT as Magnolia went down convincingly in Game 1 of the PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals on Sunday here. The Hotshots were beaten, 92-70, at Ynares Center after the Tropang 5G began to take control late in the second quarter and could only settle for falling behind to open the best-of-five affair. “I’m disappointed in the way that we played like we don’t know how we should play,” Tenorio lamented. “And I have to give it to TNT because they really scouted us and they took us away from our flow.” Tenorio and the […]...
